texts.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

虚境混沌的搅动扭曲成灵能能量的漩涡。突然间，无数的激流展开汇聚在一起，被某种看不见的力量所平息。它冷静下来，转化成了一种平和的新形态。

在观察的过程中，我们发现是一个和平之物正在指挥着这一切变化，将混沌抑制为秩序。

texts.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

The Shroud's chaotic churn warps into a writhing vortex of psionic energy. Suddenly, the multitudinous torrents unfurl and coalesce, pacified by some unseen force. It calms and spools into placid new forms.

As we observe, we become aware of an Irenic Entity orchestrating these movements, subduing the chaos into order.

Its calmness beckons us.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为和平之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Irenic Entity.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]激进地侵入虚境的混沌涡流，但无济于事。只有停止挣扎时才感觉到了和平之物真正的拥抱。

在我们心智中出现的画面是一场场势不可挡的冲突，每一场都充满了混乱和愤怒的干扰。

在这一切中，我们感受到了空洞之点尖的警惕和永恒的存在。祂平静而耐心地等待着星系无休止冲突的休止。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] reached out aggressively into the Shroud's turbulent disorder, to no avail. Only when they ceased their exertions did they feel the proper embrace of the Irenic Entity.

Images played in our minds of an overwhelming procession of conflicts, each brimming with distractions of chaos and fury.

Amid it all, we felt the watchful and timeless presence of the Hollow Point. Serene in its patience, it waits for the galaxy's ceaseless strife to finally end.

texts.zh: 尽管我们有最基本的本能，但我们的思想已经暴露在了一种奇怪的思维方式之下。
texts.en: Despite our basest instincts, our minds have been exposed to a curious way of thinking.

label.zh: 真是伤感的梦境……我们知道自己该干什么。
label.en: A wistful dream... we know our true purpose.

summary.text:
# 空洞之点尖 / Hollow Point

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 次要赞助者“空洞之点尖”的首次接触事件“虚境中的低语”（shroud.4100），由代码在虚境中自然发现时触发（common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1511），或经“虚境触及者”选项触发（须已接触全部主要赞助者）。  
  First-contact event "Whispers in the Shroud" (shroud.4100) of the minor patron "Hollow Point", launched by the game on natural discovery in the Shroud (common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1511) or by the Shroud-touched option (all major patrons must be contacted first).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- shroud.4100：单一选项“尝试沟通”按帝国类型启用机械版/蜂巢版/基础版接触项目（events/shroud_events.txt:8814，inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start_event）。  
  shroud.4100: the single option enables the robot / hive / base contact project by empire type (events/shroud_events.txt:8814, inline script minor_patron_first_contact_start_event).
- 项目成本5000（社会科技），无时限，完成后触发shroud.4105。  
  The project costs 5000 (society technology), has no time limit and fires shroud.4105 on completion.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- shroud.4105仅一个选项，把接触状态记为completed，并获得每月佐罗(Zro)产出。  
  shroud.4105 has a single option that sets the first-contact state to completed and grants monthly Zro output.
- 三个项目版本互斥，仅由帝国类型决定。  
  The three project versions are mutually exclusive and depend only on empire type.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无其他差异。  
  No other variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

- 已对照common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt、events/shroud_events.txt与inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event。  
  Compared %s, %s and the minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event inline scripts.
- 合并：原有的_HIVE与_ROBOT故事是同一接触项目的帝国类型版本，现并入本故事。  
  Merged: the former _HIVE and _ROBOT stories are the empire-type versions of the same contact project and are now part of this one story.
- 以起始事件为根并添加审阅连接。 项目标题使用游戏内的“未接触前代号”（如“Fathomless Being”），本故事标题使用赞助者名称。  
  The start event is the root, with reviewed bridges. Project titles use the in-game pre-contact code names (e.g. Fathomless Being); the story title uses the patron name.
